description: S452 — `!{}` handler arms use the §18.2 match-arm grammar with NO leading `|`: `.NotFound(reason) :> …`, `.Pair(a, b) :> …`, `else :> …`. risky() fails with NotFound("was-zero"); the pipe-less `.NotFound(reason)` arm runs and its value lands in @result. Pre-fix impl#1 silently dropped the first pipe-less arm (E-TYPE-080 / wrong arm). Driven by a user click.
rationale: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S452 "c looks right" — `!{}` handler arms are §18.2 match arms (`match-arm ::= arm-pattern (':>' | '=>' | '->') arm-body`, `variant-pattern ::= ('.' | '::') VariantName ('(' binding-list ')')?`, wildcard `else` / `_`); the `|`-prefixed spelling remains accepted. The handler is exhaustive (`else` covers .Empty), and the recovery value "recovered: was-zero" is the final cell value.
